12/09/2026
ريحة نفس حيوانك الأليف لو مستمرة، ما تعتبرهاش حاجة عادية.
رائحة الفم المستمرة ممكن تكون علامة على مشكلة محتاجة تتشاف، زي تراكم الجير، التهاب اللثة، مشكلة في أحد الأسنان أو أسباب تانية.
وعشان كده المهم مش إننا نتعامل مع الريحة بس
المهم نعرف إيه اللي مسببها.
فحص الفم والأسنان هو أول خطوة عشان نعرف السبب ونحدد الحل المناسب.
لو ريحة فم أليفك مزعجه و مستمرة، احجز و اطمن عليه ♥️

If your pet’s bad breath keeps coming back, don’t ignore it.
Persistent bad breath can be a sign of an underlying dental or oral problem, such as tartar buildup, gum inflammation, a dental issue, or other causes.
That’s why the goal isn’t just to deal with the smell
It’s to find out what’s causing it.
A proper oral and dental examination is the first step toward understanding the problem and choosing the right solution.
If your pet’s bad breath is persistent, book a dental check-up at Pets Valley.

Listening to the heartbeat is an important part of every check-up, but sometimes we need a closer look to make sure the heart is beating normally, That’s where an ECG comes in.
It records the heart’s electrical activity and helps the veterinarian check the heart rate and rhythm, as well as detect some heart rhythm problems.
A simple test that can provide valuable information about your pet’s heart.🩺🫀

On International Dog Day
Having a dog means having a loyal companion, a loving presence, and countless little moments that make life better.
Keeping them healthy takes more than food and play. Regular check-ups, vaccinations, dental care, and noticing any changes in their appetite or behavior all make a difference.
And that’s why we’re here, to support you in caring for your pet at every stage of their life.
Because real care starts before they get sick.
Make this day special and give your dog the care they deserve.

Sometimes, a small act can make a real difference. Providing clean water, helping an injured animal, supporting rescuers, or simply choosing not to hurt or scare them can help save a life.
As we believe veterinary medicine is not just about treatment. It is also about compassion, responsibility, and awareness.
Share this message. Your awareness could be the first step toward saving a life.

Keeping up with your pet's vaccination schedule, along with regular check-ups, helps them stay healthy through every stage of life and gives them the protection they need.
Remember, prevention is always easier and better than treatment.
Not sure which vaccine your pet needs or when the next dose is due?

Happy International Cat Day to the cutest members of our families.
Did you know that cats are experts at hiding pain and illness? That's why health issues can sometimes go unnoticed until they become more serious.
Regular checkups can make all the difference and should include:
• Routine examinations
• Vaccinations and preventive care
• Dental checkups
• Monitoring appetite and weight
• Watching for any changes in behavior or activity
At Pets Valley, we believe every cat deserves the care it needs to stay healthy and happy.
If it's been a while since your cat's last checkup, this is the perfect time to book a wellness visit.
